results.question: What are the top 10 accounts by pack units this quarter?
results.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

results.question: What is our market share for Zenovax in the Docetaxel market?
results.sql:
WITH num AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND upper(p.drug_name) = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory = ANY(%s)
), den AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory = ANY(%s)
)
SELECT n.value AS numerator, d.value AS denominator,
       n.value / NULLIF(d.value, 0) AS value
FROM num n CROSS JOIN den d

answer.headline: Market share is 113.78% (42,170.25 equivalents against a reported market of 37,064 equivalents).
answer.period_note: Reporting window: r3m — the rolling 3 months (current month plus the two prior).
notes: This window includes the current reporting period, which is still accumulating.
warnings: Market share here divides our distributor volume by the reported market total. In this dataset the market source contains only competitor products, so the denominator understates the true total market. Treat these percentages as indicative of relative position, not as a reliable share.
This value exceeds 100%, which is not a real market share. It means the reported market volume is smaller than our own shipments, so the sources are inconsistent rather than the share being genuine.

results.message: Market share is 113.78% (42,170.25 equivalents against a reported market of 37,064 equivalents).

results.question: Which accounts grew the most versus the prior quarter?
results.reason: plan matches and the request succeeded

plan.interpretation: Growth of the last quarter against the quarter immediately prior, ranked by top performers.

results.sql:
WITH cur AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
), pri AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.dim0_id, p.dim0_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(c.dim0_label, p.dim0_label) AS dim0_label, c.value AS current_value, p.value AS prior_value,
       (c.value - p.value) / NULLIF(p.value, 0) AS value
FROM cur c FULL OUTER JOIN pri p ON COALESCE(c.dim0_id::text, %s) = COALESCE(p.dim0_id::text, %s)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

results.question: What is the generic share in the Platinum Compounds market?

plan.interpretation: Generic share in the Platinum Compounds market is measured as the proportion of reported market volume held by generic products, using the current rolling 3-month window (r3m).

results.sql:
WITH num AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
LEFT JOIN app_ref.product_classification c ON c.ndc = p.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND c.classification = ANY(%s)
), den AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s)
), unk AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
LEFT JOIN app_ref.product_classification c ON c.ndc = p.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND c.classification = 'unknown'
)
SELECT n.value AS numerator, d.value AS denominator,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.value, 0) < d.value
            THEN COALESCE(n.value, 0) / NULLIF(d.value, 0) END AS value,
       COALESCE(u.value, 0) AS unclassified,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.value, 0) < d.value
            THEN (COALESCE(n.value, 0) + COALESCE(u.value, 0)) / NULLIF(d.value, 0) END AS value_upper
FROM num n CROSS JOIN den d
CROSS JOIN unk u

answer.headline: Market segment share: 70.06%.
answer.period_note: Reporting window: r3m — the rolling 3 months (current month plus the two prior).
notes: Generic share in the Platinum Compounds market is measured as the proportion of reported market volume held by generic products, using the current rolling 3-month window (r3m).
This window includes the current reporting period, which is still accumulating.
warnings: Generic, biosimilar and branded-competitor are not columns of the source data, which marks only our own brands. They come from the classification mapping supplied 1.0.0 (sha256 2618110565ef).
